Delete All Tournaments
Warning: This action will permanently delete ALL tournament winners from the database.

This action cannot be undone. All tournament data will be permanently removed.

This must match exactly "DELETE" (all caps)
Delete League Confirmation
WARNING: This action will permanently delete the entire league including:
  • All matches and results
  • All rounds
  • All standings snapshots
  • The current season

This action cannot be undone!

This is required to prevent accidental deletion.
Deactivate League Confirmation
WARNING: This action will deactivate the current league season:
  • The league will be marked as inactive
  • Players will not be able to view or interact with the league
  • All data will be preserved and can be reactivated later

You can reactivate the league at any time.

This is required to prevent accidental deactivation.
Finish League Confirmation
Finish this league season?
  • The league will be marked as Finished
  • The season end date will be set to today
  • Final standings will be locked - match results can no longer be edited
  • The champion is crowned and the season appears in the Hall of Champions
  • All data is preserved - you can reopen the league at any time
This is required to prevent accidental finishing.
Reset League Confirmation
WARNING: This action will reset the entire league:
  • All match results will be cleared
  • All rounds will be deleted
  • Standings will be reset to zero
  • Current season will be preserved but reset

This action cannot be undone!

This is required to prevent accidental reset.
